mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_dashboard_snapshot ( corp_id, snapshot_date, metric_type, metric_data, detail_data, raw_json, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{corpId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{metricType}, CAST(#{metricData} AS jsonb), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{detailData,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') AS jsonb), #{rawJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (corp_id, snapshot_date, metric_type) DO UPDATE SET metric_data = EXCLUDED.metric_data, detail_data = EXCLUDED.detail_data, raw_json = EXCLUDED.raw_json, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, corp_id, snapshot_date, metric_type, CAST(metric_data AS text) AS metric_data, CAST(detail_data AS text) AS detail_data, raw_json, created_at, updated_at FROM crm_dashboard_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = #{snapshotDate} AND metric_type = #{metricType} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, corp_id, snapshot_date, metric_type, CAST(metric_data AS text) AS metric_data, CAST(detail_data AS text) AS detail_data, raw_json, created_at, updated_at FROM crm_dashboard_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = #{snapshotDate} ORDER BY metric_type
